name: CR2020

dimensions.note: Panasonic ML2020 and VL2020 datasheets publish maximum dimensions only; nominal is set to the maximum.

variants.notes: No CR2020 datasheet was located, so capacity and weight are not published here.

variants.label: ML2020

capacity_mah.conditions: Panasonic nominal capacity at 0.12mA standard drain to 2.0V, 20°C

variants.notes: ML2020 is a rechargeable battery in the same case. About 1,000 charge-discharge cycles at 10% discharge depth, constant-voltage charging only. Not a drop-in replacement for the single-use CR battery unless the device is designed for it. Charging voltage 2.8 to 3.2V.

variants.label: VL2020

capacity_mah.conditions: Panasonic nominal capacity at 0.07mA standard drain to 2.5V, 20°C

variants.notes: VL2020 is a rechargeable battery in the same case. About 1,000 charge-discharge cycles at 10% discharge depth, constant-voltage charging only. Not a drop-in replacement for the single-use CR battery unless the device is designed for it. Charging voltage 3.25 to 3.55V.

interchange.note: Same 20mm width and 0.4mm thinner; lower capacity and may make poor contact in a CR2020 holder.
Same 20mm width and 0.5mm thicker; fits only where the holder has the clearance.

notes: The ML2020 and VL2020 are the commonly sold rechargeable batteries in this size.

Button batteries and other swallowed batteries

safety: Swallowed coin batteries can cause severe internal burns within two hours. Keep batteries away from children, and seek emergency medical care immediately if one is swallowed or placed in the nose or ears.
In the United States, the National Battery Ingestion Hotline is 1-800-498-8666 and Poison Help is 1-800-222-1222.
Do not recharge, crush, puncture, heat or short-circuit a single-use lithium coin battery.
